<documents>
<document id="cushion-negative-after-dispute">
NegativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆYourˆbalanceˆcanˆgoˆnegativeˆwhenˆweˆtakeˆbackˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned.ˆThisˆisn'tˆCushion,ˆandˆitˆcanˆhappenˆonˆanyˆplan,ˆincludingˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆlendˆyouˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆinvestigated.ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆweˆgiveˆyouˆwrittenˆnoticeˆandˆtakeˆitˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater.ˆIfˆyou'veˆspentˆitˆinˆtheˆmeantime,ˆtheˆbalanceˆcanˆdropˆbelowˆzero.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆyourˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆincomingˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆ##ˆFeesˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆforˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆisn'tˆrepaidˆAsˆwithˆCushion,ˆifˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆlastsˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆOnˆPlusˆandˆPremium,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆwhileˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆnegativeˆforˆlongerˆthanˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCan'tˆpayˆitˆrightˆaway?ˆMessageˆsupport.ˆIfˆyou'reˆgoingˆthroughˆfinancialˆhardship,ˆweˆcanˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="overdraft-no-fees">
Doˆyouˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfees?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆorˆnon-sufficientˆfundsˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆinsteadˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆhaveˆenoughˆmoney,ˆtheˆtransactionˆisˆsimplyˆdeclined.ˆThere'sˆnoˆchargeˆforˆaˆdecline.ˆ##ˆCushionˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆturnˆonˆCushion,ˆwhichˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆwhenˆyourˆbalanceˆrunsˆshort,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆCushionˆcoversˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ$200ˆonˆPremium.ˆItˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCanˆmyˆbalanceˆstillˆgoˆnegative?ˆRarely.ˆItˆcanˆhappenˆwhenˆaˆmerchantˆchargesˆmoreˆthanˆitˆfirstˆauthorized,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆtipˆaddedˆtoˆaˆrestaurantˆbill,ˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆpaymentsˆIfˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆorˆanˆACHˆdebitˆcan'tˆbeˆpaid,ˆit'sˆreturnedˆunpaid,ˆwithˆnoˆfeeˆfromˆus.ˆTheˆcompanyˆyouˆoweˆmayˆchargeˆitsˆownˆlateˆfee.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-repayment">
RepayingˆCushionˆWhenˆCushionˆcoversˆaˆpurchase,ˆyourˆbalanceˆgoesˆbelowˆzero.ˆHere'sˆhowˆitˆgetsˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆAutomaticˆrepaymentˆAnyˆmoneyˆthatˆcomesˆin,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆrefund,ˆgoesˆtowardˆtheˆnegativeˆbalanceˆfirst.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆyourselfˆYouˆcanˆaddˆmoneyˆatˆanyˆtimeˆbyˆtransfer,ˆBrookPayˆfromˆanotherˆmember,ˆorˆaˆcashˆdepositˆatˆaˆstore.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆstaysˆnegativeˆ-ˆAfterˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆuntilˆyou'reˆbackˆatˆzeroˆandˆmeetˆtheˆdirectˆdepositˆrequirementˆagain.ˆ-ˆAfterˆ60ˆdays,ˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestricted.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆaddˆmoney,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆspendˆorˆsendˆitˆuntilˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterestˆforˆusingˆCushion,ˆandˆnoneˆforˆrepayingˆlate.ˆTheˆonlyˆconsequencesˆareˆsuspensionˆandˆrestriction.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccountˆwhileˆit'sˆnegative?ˆNo.ˆBringˆtheˆbalanceˆtoˆzeroˆfirst.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What happens if I don't pay back my Cushion balance?

response.text: {"answer":"Any money deposited or transferred into your account is applied to the negative balance first, or you can add money yourself. There are no fees or interest for late repayment. If the balance stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended; after 60 days, your account is restricted until the balance is repaid.
